title: Syntex Norethindrone Synthesis
summary: At the pharmaceutical company Syntex in Mexico City, chemist Luis Miramontes, assisted by Carl Djerassi and George Rosenkranz, synthesised norethindrone in 1951. It was an orally active synthetic progestin effective at low doses, unlike progesterone, and later became a key ingredient of birth control pills.

uncertainty.note: Britannica dates the step to 15 October 1951; the Embryo Project says only 1951 and credits Djerassi alone.

importance.justification: First synthesis of an orally effective progestin later used in birth control pills.
